title: Beef and Dumplings
creator: Nicole McLaughlin (Allrecipes)
cookTime: About 3 hours 45 minutes (roast ~3 hours + dumplings 30-40 minutes)
ingredients: 5 cups water, plus more if needed
1 1/2 tablespoons beef bouillon paste (such as Better than Bouillon)
instructions: Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Season the roast all over with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Place chuck roast in the Dutch oven and cook, undisturbed, until browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Flip and cook for another 4 minutes. Remove roast from the pot and set aside.

Add butter to the drippings and let it melt. Add onion and celery and cook, stirring often, until softened. Add flour and cook for about 1 minute longer. Whisk in water, bouillon paste, and cream of mushroom soup. Bring mixture to a simmer, stirring occasionally.
Return roast to pot and bring it back to a simmer. Cover, reduce heat, and cook until roast is very tender, about 3 hours.
Remove roast from pot. Shred the beef and discard any pieces of fat. Add meat back to the pot and increase heat to medium-high.

Once pot comes to a boil, drop dumplings into the broth and, if using, peas and carrots. Maintain a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for 30 to 40 minutes, until the dumplings are done. If more liquid is needed, add up to 1 1/2 cups more water. Adjust seasoning with more salt and pepper if desired. Serve garnished with fresh parsley.
notes: From an Allrecipes Facebook Reel / Allrecipes page by Nicole McLaughlin: https://www.allrecipes.com/beef-and-dumplings-recipe-12136895. Description notes frozen dumplings can be swapped for homemade dumplings or canned biscuits cut into pieces and rolled flat.
